description:
Open (or re-open) the creator store for a token page. Idempotent per token page. Needs a Developer plan or Developer Beta membership, and the manager role on the token page.

Params: page (the token page's symbol or address, e.g. 'FLUXGP' or 'chaindaddy.io/FLUXGP/base') OR chain_key (string, e.g. 'base') with crown_id (number, the token page's registration id); session_token?, idempotency_key?
Returns: {ok, idempotency_key, store: {id, chainId, chainKey, crownId, symbol, tokenAddress, tokenDecimals, tokenOrigin, feeBps, payoutAddress, status, live, …}}
Errors: NO_CREDENTIALS, NO_SESSION, NO_JWT, IAP_PLAN_REQUIRED, INVALID_PARAMS, PAGE_NOT_FOUND, PAGE_AMBIGUOUS (the symbol has several pages; the message lists them), HTTP_403, HTTP_404

chain_key.description: Chain key of the token page, e.g. 'base', 'solana' (with crown_id; or with page, to pick one of a symbol's pages)

crown_id.description: Registration id of the token page (with chain_key)

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency-Key for this write. Omit to generate one; reuse the returned idempotency_key to retry safely

page.description: The token page, instead of chain_key and crown_id: its symbol ('FLUXGP') or its address ('chaindaddy.io/FLUXGP/base')

session_token.description: Session token from authenticate. Optional when CHAINDADDY_API_KEY is set (or, for store-scoped tools, CHAINDADDY_IAP_KEY)

name: iap_open_store
title: Open a creator store
